changes: Fixed a real bug: Board leaderboard's "This Month" view broke the table layout (the shared table CSS was tuned for the all-time view's 8 columns, not 4). Rebuilt as a clean list instead of a table, sidestepping the issue entirely.
Polished the All Time / This Month pills on both leaderboards — same gradient/shadow treatment as the working Leaderboard/Floor tabs, rather than a separate flat style.

Optimized Casino leaderboard's "This Month" — now queries Firebase server-side for just this month's entries instead of downloading someone's entire XP log and filtering client-side. This was the real cause of it feeling slow.
Turned the Casino ambience down further, per feedback.
